facts.text: I'm hungry. Not me, him. Okay, both of us. Where's the chocolate? And a fish tank.
facts.why: Invented. It is not on the opened quote page. A real Venom line that fits the lobster tank cue is the 'Fuel in the tank' reply to Eddie.
Wikipedia's plot calls Riot the fourth symbiote, the one that escapes in Malaysia.
